name: Proton Drive Sync
author: zakko
description: Proton Drive, finally on your Omarchy bar. Pick a folder on your machine and one in Drive: create, edit, rename, or move on either side and the other side follows. Your password stays on Proton's sign-in page. Pause, resume, and keep both conflict copies from the chip. Deletes go to recycle or Trash, and a large change waits for you.
